components.name: Glass Dialog
components.description: White glass panel, an elevated surface alongside the sheet, dock and toasts.
components.css: .ds-glass{width:320px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(11,18,32,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(1.2);backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(1.2);color:#0b1220;box-shadow:0 18px 44px -14px rgba(15,23,42,.22),0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.07),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);overflow:hidden}.ds-glass-head{padding:16px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,18,32,.1);font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-glass-body{padding:24px;font-size:15px}

components.name: Home Dock
components.description: Three-cell white glass pane under the name: class info, classmates, timeline; each cell a snap target and a shortcut into the sheet.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));width:560px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(11,18,32,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(1.2);backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(1.2);box-shadow:0 18px 44px -14px rgba(15,23,42,.22),0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.07),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}.ds-dock-cell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:92px;padding:16px 24px;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:left;color:#0b1220;transition:background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-dock-cell+.ds-dock-cell{border-left:1px solid rgba(11,18,32,.1)}.ds-dock-cell:first-child{border-radius:18px 0 0 18px}.ds-dock-cell:last-child{border-radius:0 18px 18px 0}.ds-dock-cell:hover{background:rgba(11,18,32,.04)}.ds-dock-cell:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0b1220;outline-offset:-2px}.ds-dock-label{font-size:13px;color:#566173}.ds-dock-value{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Bracket Mark
components.description: Four corner strokes around a coral point; brand mark and cursor.
components.css: .ds-mark{position:relative;display:block;width:18px;height:18px;background:linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) left top/6px 1.5px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) left top/1.5px 6px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) right top/6px 1.5px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) right top/1.5px 6px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) left bottom/6px 1.5px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) left bottom/1.5px 6px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) right bottom/6px 1.5px no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0b1220,#0b1220) right bottom/1.5px 6px no-repeat}.ds-mark::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff6a3d}

narrative.overview: The class name is a body of dark pigment dispersed on a white page. The ground is pure white, the marks are near-black cool ink, and one flat coral accent marks the single thing worth doing next. The public face is an Experience surface: full-bleed, no page scroll, a particle name the cursor can grab, a slogan beneath it and a three-cell glass dock. Console and admin are Operate surfaces in the same material: plain, dense, hairline-structured.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, one coral accent.
Hairline borders (10% and 24% ink alpha) carry all structure.
White frosted glass for the info sheet, the home dock, dialogs and toasts only.
Four-corner bracket is the signature: cursor (leans toward the pointer while snapped), brand mark, keyboard focus on the stage.
4px spacing base; 6/10/18px radii; Geist plus Noto Sans SC, tabular numerals for data.

rules.name: The One Flare Rule
rules.body: Coral appears on the primary action, the "start" entry, the brand mark's center dot, selection and caret. Nothing else, and never as glow or gradient text.

rules.name: The Two Tone Rule
rules.body: Every other surface is bg or fg at some alpha. Status hues are for state, not emphasis.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence-case at their natural weight; hierarchy never leans on uppercase, tracking tricks, or small tagged lines above headings.

rules.name: The Glass Is Rare Rule
rules.body: White glass is reserved for the info sheet, the home dock, dialogs and toasts. Operate surfaces (console, admin) never use it, and nothing else on the home stage becomes a pane.

dos: Do build new surfaces from bg grounds, fg text, and hairline rules.
Do spend coral only on the one primary action per view.
Do use tokens (`--bg-*`, `--fg-*`, `--s-*`, `--r-*`, `--ease-*`, `--dur-*`) and named springs; no literal curves.
Do keep every state change reversible and respect reduced motion.
Do use tabular numerals wherever data lives.
donts: Don't add glow halos, gradient text, or a second accent hue.
Don't use glass on console or admin surfaces, or on home elements beyond the sheet and dock.
Don't reach for hero banners, card grids, or scrolling marketing pages on the public face.
Don't add calligraphy, seals, brush strokes or other motif decoration.
Don't use linear tweens for UI motion.
